metadata.description: powerbi-agent-mcp: an MCP server that connects your AI agent to your own Power BI / Fabric tenant, with the guardrails in code, plus the rules and skills the agent follows

plugins.name: powerbi-agent
plugins.description: Power BI dashboard building for AI agents: the powerbi-agent MCP server (list workspaces and items, model schema, read-only DAX, download/validate/deploy PBIR reports with guardrails, date-filter pins, page captures, refresh history) and three skills (build, review, verify). Needs Python 3.11+, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, `az login`, and a config.yaml (see docs/SETUP.md).
